scope: Installed official Base/modules and DLC/*/modules; original art only; no gameplay changes.

integration.import_files: Every entries[].art path in shell and game
integration.art_rules: Original distinct WHITE RGBA PNGs in ALL categories, including civilization emblems. Preserve native owner tint/mask rendering. Transparent margins and alpha silhouettes required. Upgrade tiers and named individuals of one great-person base unit share one original image.
integration.excluded: Wonders, leaders, resources, generic UI slot buttons; civ backgrounds and all gameplay preserved.
